Then all the commanders of the forces, along with Johanan son of Kareah, Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least to the greatest, approached
Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan, the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah, the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least to the greatest, came near,
眾軍長和加利亞的兒子約哈難，並何沙雅的兒子耶撒尼亞（又名亞撒利雅，見四十三章二節）以及眾百姓，從最小的到至大的都進前來，
Jeremiah the prophet and said, “May our petition come before you; pray to the LORD your God on behalf of this entire remnant. For few of us remain of the many, as you can see with your own eyes.

And said to Jeremiah the prophet, Let our request come before you, and make prayer for us to the Lord your God, even for this small band of us; for we are only a small band out of what was a great number, as your eyes may see:
對先知耶利米說：「求你准我們在你面前祈求，為我們這剩下的人禱告耶和華─你的神。我們本來眾多，現在剩下的極少，這是你親眼所見的。
Pray that the LORD your God will tell us the way we should walk and the thing we should do.”
That the Lord your God may make clear to us the way in which we are to go and what we are to do.
願耶和華─你的神指示我們所當走的路，所當做的事。」
“I have heard you,” replied Jeremiah the prophet. “I will surely pray to the LORD your God as you request, and I will tell you everything that the LORD answers; I will not withhold a word from you.”

Then Jeremiah the prophet said to them, I have given ear to you; see, I will make prayer to the Lord your God, as you have said; and it will be that, whatever the Lord may say in answer to you, I will give you word of it, keeping nothing back.
先知耶利米對他們說：「我已經聽見你們了，我必照著你們的話禱告耶和華─你們的神。耶和華無論回答甚麼，我必都告訴你們，毫不隱瞞。」
Then they said to Jeremiah, “May the LORD be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not act upon every word that the LORD your God sends you to tell us.
Then they said to Jeremiah, May the Lord be a true witness against us in good faith, if we do not do everything which the Lord your God sends you to say to us.
於是他們對耶利米說：「我們若不照耶和華─你的神差遣你來說的一切話行，願耶和華在我們中間作真實誠信的見證。
Whether it is pleasant or unpleasant, we will obey the voice of the LORD our God to whom we are sending you, so that it may go well with us, for we will obey the voice of the LORD our God!”
If it is good or if it is evil, we will be guided by the voice of the Lord our God, to whom we are sending you; so that it may be well for us when we give ear to the voice of the Lord our God.
我們現在請你到耶和華─我們的神面前，他說的無論是好是歹，我們都必聽從；我們聽從耶和華─我們神的話，就可以得福。」
After ten days the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah,
And it came about that after ten days the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah.
過了十天，耶和華的話臨到耶利米。
and he summoned Johanan son of Kareah, all the commanders of the forces who were with him, and all the people from the least to the greatest.
And he sent for Johanan, the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were still with him, and all the people, from the least to the greatest,
他就將加利亞的兒子約哈難和同著他的眾軍長，並眾百姓，從最小的到至大的都叫了來，
Jeremiah told them, “Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your petition:
And said to them, These are the words of the Lord, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to put your request before him:
對他們說：「耶和華─以色列的神，就是你們請我在他面前為你們祈求的主，如此說：
‘If you will indeed stay in this land, then I will build you up and not tear you down; I will plant you and not uproot you, for I will relent of the disaster I have brought upon you.
If you still go on living in the land, then I will go on building you up and not pulling you down, planting you and not uprooting you: for my purpose of doing evil to you has been changed.
『你們若仍住在這地，我就建立你們，必不拆毀，栽植你們，並不拔出，因我為降與你們的災禍後悔了。
Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon, whom you now fear; do not be afraid of him, declares the LORD, for I am with you to save you and deliver you from him.
Have no fear of the king of Babylon, of whom you are now in fear; have no fear of him, says the Lord: for I am with you to keep you safe and to give you salvation from his hands.
不要怕你們所怕的巴比倫王』」。耶和華說：「不要怕他！因為我與你們同在，要拯救你們脫離他的手。
And I will show you compassion, and he will have compassion on you and restore you to your own land.’
And I will have mercy on you, so that he may have mercy on you and let you go back to your land.
我也要使他發憐憫，好憐憫你們，叫你們歸回本地。
But if you say, ‘We will not stay in this land,’ and you thus disobey the voice of the LORD your God,
But if you say, We have no desire to go on living in this land; and do not give ear to the voice of the Lord your God,
倘若你們說：『我們不住在這地』，以致不聽從耶和華─你們神的話，
and if you say, ‘No, but we will go to the land of Egypt and live there, where we will not see war or hear the sound of the ram’s horn or hunger for bread,’
Saying, No, but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we will not see war, or be hearing the sound of the horn, or be in need of food; there we will make our living-place;
說：『我們不住這地，卻要進入埃及地，在那裡看不見爭戰，聽不見角聲，也不致無食飢餓。我們必住在那裡。』
then hear the word of the LORD, O remnant of Judah! This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you are determined to go to Egypt and reside there,
Then give ear now to the word of the Lord, O you last of Judah: the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said, If your minds are fixed on going into Egypt and stopping there;
你們所剩下的猶大人哪，現在要聽耶和華的話。萬軍之耶和華─以色列的神如此說：『你們若定意要進入埃及，在那裡寄居，
then the sword you fear will overtake you there, and the famine you dread will follow on your heels into Egypt, and you will die there.

Then it will come about that the sword, which is the cause of your fear, will overtake you there in the land of Egypt, and need of food, which you are fearing, will go after you there in Egypt; and there death will come to you.
你們所懼怕的刀劍在埃及地必追上你們！你們所懼怕的饑荒在埃及要緊緊地跟隨你們！你們必死在那裡！
So all who resolve to go to Egypt to reside there will die by sword and famine and plague. Not one of them will survive or escape the disaster I will bring upon them.’

Such will be the fate of all the men whose minds are fixed on going into Egypt and stopping there; they will come to their end by the sword, by being short of food, and by disease: not one of them will keep his life or get away from the evil which I will send on them.
凡定意要進入埃及在那裡寄居的必遭刀劍、饑荒、瘟疫而死，無一人存留，逃脫我所降與他們的災禍。』

For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘Just as My anger and wrath were poured out on the residents of Jerusalem, so will My wrath be poured out on you if you go to Egypt. You will become an object of cursing and horror, of vilification and disgrace, and you will never see this place again.’

For this is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said: As my wrath and passion have been let loose on the people of Jerusalem, so will my passion be let loose on you when you go into Egypt: and you will become an oath and a cause of wonder and a curse and a name of shame; and you will never see this place again.
「萬軍之耶和華─以色列的神如此說：『我怎樣將我的怒氣和忿怒傾在耶路撒冷的居民身上，你們進入埃及的時候，我也必照樣將我的忿怒傾在你們身上，以致你們令人辱罵、驚駭、咒詛、羞辱，你們不得再見這地方。』
The LORD has told you, O remnant of Judah, ‘Do not go to Egypt.’ Know for sure that I have warned you today!
The Lord has said about you, O last of Judah, Go not into Egypt: be certain that I have given witness to you this day.
所剩下的猶大人哪，耶和華論到你們說：『不要進入埃及去。』你們要確實地知道我今日警教你們了。
For you have deceived yourselves by sending me to the LORD your God, saying, ‘Pray to the LORD our God on our behalf, and as for all that the LORD our God says, tell it to us and we will do it.’

For you have been acting with deceit in your hearts; for you sent me to the Lord your God, saying, Make prayer for us to the Lord our God, and give us word of everything he may say, and we will do it.
你們行詭詐自害；因為你們請我到耶和華─你們的神那裡，說：『求你為我們禱告耶和華─我們神，照耶和華─我們的神一切所說的告訴我們，我們就必遵行。』
For I have told you today, but you have not obeyed the voice of the LORD your God in all He has sent me to tell you.
And this day I have made it clear to you, and you have not given ear to the voice of the Lord your God in anything for which he has sent me to you.
我今日將這話告訴你們，耶和華─你們的神為你們的事差遣我到你們那裡說的，你們卻一樣沒有聽從。
Now therefore, know for sure that by sword and famine and plague you will die in the place where you desire to go to reside.”
And now be certain that you will come to your end by the sword and by being short of food and by disease, in the place to which you are pleased to go for a living-place.
現在你們要確實地知道，你們在所要去寄居之地必遭刀劍、饑荒、瘟疫而死。」
